description: This file defines a FastAPI router with a single GET endpoint '/search' that allows searching notes by query. It utilizes dependencies for database session and user identification, and calls a service function to retrieve matching notes, returning a list of NoteDTO objects.

methods.description: API endpoint handler for searching notes based on a query string, invoking the service layer and returning matching notes.
